editorial:
Imagine you are running for your life from a government that has gone completely off the rails. That is exactly where you start in this creepy ride. You follow a family trying to escape to safety, but they end up in a safe house that is anything but safe. The vibe is super tense from the start because you feel the pressure of the state hunting them down, while at the same time, you realize the house they are hiding in has a dark, evil history. It feels like a trap where the walls are closing in on them, and you will spend most of the movie wondering if the people outside are scarier than whatever is lurking inside the building.

What really works here is the acting and the way the suspense builds up. The twists will actually surprise you, and the pacing keeps you on your toes without feeling too slow. One downside is that some of the scary parts might be a bit too much if you are squeamish, but for horror fans, it is a win. You should definitely check this out if you like stories about survival and ghosts.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the house is a gateway for evil spirits that feed on fear and pain. The family discovers that the safe house was actually a place of torture. In the final scenes, the main characters have to fight both the ghosts and the government soldiers. It wraps up with a shocking twist where the cycle of violence continues, leaving you wondering if anyone truly escaped the darkness of the house.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy houses and dystopian futures.
